import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

/** Compiles the production AlphaFilesPlugin.storageSelect and DailyAppsPlugin.pickedDetails bodies
 * over closed ports, and prints what the preview subtitle receives. */
public class AlphaFileDetailsTest {
 static final class JSObject {
  final Map<String,Object> values=new TreeMap<>();
  void put(String key,Object value){values.put(key,value);}
  @Override public String toString(){StringBuilder out=new StringBuilder();for(String key:List.of("status","size","modified"))out.append(key).append('=').append(values.getOrDefault(key,"-")).append(';');return out.toString();}
 }
 static final class PluginCall {
  final String path;JSObject result;
  PluginCall(String path){this.path=path;}
  String getString(String key,String fallback){return "path".equals(key)?path:fallback;}
 }
 static final class Uri {}
 static final class StorageBrowser {
  final Path root;
  StorageBrowser(Path root){this.root=root;}
  File resolve(String path,boolean allowRoot){return root.resolve(path).toFile();}
  static String mime(String name){return "text/plain";}
 }
 static final class SelectedDocumentAccess {static String authorize(Object context,Uri uri,int flags){return "selection";}}
 static final class OpenableColumns {static final String SIZE="_size";}
 static final class DocumentsContract {static final class Document {static final String COLUMN_LAST_MODIFIED="last_modified";}}
 /** A provider row: a column the provider does not know throws, as some providers do. */
 static final class Cursor implements AutoCloseable {
  final Long value;
  Cursor(Long value){this.value=value;}
  boolean moveToFirst(){return true;}
  boolean isNull(int column){return value==null;}
  long getLong(int column){return value;}
  @Override public void close(){}
 }
 /** The production code names android.content.ContentResolver; this nested class takes that name. */
 static final class android {static final class content {static final class ContentResolver {
  final Map<String,Long> columns;final Set<String> refused;
  ContentResolver(Map<String,Long> columns,Set<String> refused){this.columns=columns;this.refused=refused;}
  Cursor query(Uri uri,String[] projection,String selection,String[] args,String order){
   if(refused.contains(projection[0]))throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown column");
   return new Cursor(columns.get(projection[0]));
  }
 }}}

 private final StorageBrowser browser;
 AlphaFileDetailsTest(Path root){browser=new StorageBrowser(root);}
 private static JSObject result(String status,String message){JSObject out=new JSObject();out.put("status",status);return out;}
 private interface StorageWork {JSObject run(StorageBrowser browser)throws Exception;}
 private void storage(PluginCall call,StorageWork work){
  try{call.result=work.run(browser);}
  catch(FileNotFoundException missing){call.result=result("missing","This item is no longer there.");}
  catch(Exception error){throw new AssertionError(error);}
 }
 private Object getContext(){return null;}
 private Uri contentUri(File file){return new Uri();}
 /* production select */
 /* production picked */

 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  switch(args[0]){
   case "select":{
    Path root=Files.createTempDirectory("alpha-file-details-");
    try{
     Path file=root.resolve("notes.txt");Files.writeString(file,"twelve bytes");
     file.toFile().setLastModified(1600000000000L);
     AlphaFileDetailsTest fixture=new AlphaFileDetailsTest(root);
     PluginCall call=new PluginCall("notes.txt");fixture.storageSelect(call);System.out.println(call.result);
     PluginCall gone=new PluginCall("gone.txt");fixture.storageSelect(gone);System.out.println(gone.result);
    }finally{
     try(java.util.stream.Stream<Path> entries=Files.walk(root)){for(Path entry:entries.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toArray(Path[]::new))Files.delete(entry);}
    }
    break;
   }
   case "picked":{
    Map<String,Long> both=new HashMap<>();both.put("_size",2048L);both.put("last_modified",1600000000000L);
    Map<String,Long> unknown=new HashMap<>();unknown.put("_size",null);unknown.put("last_modified",0L);
    for(android.content.ContentResolver resolver:List.of(
      new android.content.ContentResolver(both,Set.of()),
      new android.content.ContentResolver(unknown,Set.of()),
      new android.content.ContentResolver(both,Set.of("last_modified")))){
     JSObject value=new JSObject();value.put("status","selected");pickedDetails(resolver,new Uri(),value);System.out.println(value);
    }
    break;
   }
   default:throw new AssertionError(args[0]);
  }
 }
}
